authority: derived-rebuildable-non-authoritative; source is the PostgreSQL codex authority plus the pending amendment request below; this file writes business rules only and implements nothing
principle: SQL+RAG-family+CAG+DAG ride one native integration plane. PostgreSQL is the sole structured business-data authority. Each capability has exactly one of the eight codex languages as owner. No Python hop. No new authority, scheduler, store, governor, or capability. Concrete planners, executors, pipeline order, tool choices, and storage implementations belong to subordinate owner contracts per B5.
